response.original_title: Arte della Moneta nel Tardo Impero
response.overview: This critofilm illustrates the relationship between figurative art and numismatic decorations. The commentary lists the main iconographic themes, emphasizing stylistic evolution: “from Roman realism to Byzantine abstraction,” “from Hellenistic vitalism to the stark, striking graphic synthesis of the Middle Ages.”
response.title: Arte della Moneta nel Tardo Impero
